title: Chain complex C_•(Φ, V) of φ-isotypic chains
body_html:
Chain complex $C_\bullet(\Phi, V)$

Let $\Phi = (\mathscr{K}_+, \phi)$ be a compatible system of semisimple characters (see [[node:coefficient_systems.semisimple_character_T_axioms]]) and let $V \in \Rep(G)$. Define $$C_\bullet(\Phi, V) \;:=\; \mathrm{span}\{ \mathcal{F} \otimes v \;|\; v \in V[\phi_\mathcal{F}] \} \;\subseteq\; C_\bullet(\BSigma) \otimes_R V,$$ graded by the dimension of facets.

By (T2), the boundary $\partial$ on $C_\bullet(\BSigma)$ extends to a boundary on $C_\bullet(\Phi, V)$, giving the augmented complex $$0 \to C_d(\Phi, V) \to \cdots \to C_0(\Phi, V) \xrightarrow{\epsilon_V} V \to 0,$$ with $\epsilon_V(\sum_x x \otimes v_x) = \sum_x v_x$.

$G$-module structure via compact induction

$C_\bullet(\BSigma) \otimes V$ carries the diagonal $G$-action $g \cdot (\mathcal{F} \otimes v) = g\mathcal{F} \otimes gv$. By (T3), $V[\phi_\mathcal{F}]$ is a $\hat K_\mathcal{F}$-module, and:

Lemma. $C_\bullet(\Phi, V) \subseteq C_\bullet(\BSigma) \otimes V$ is a $G$-submodule, and $$C_d(\Phi, V) \;=\; \bigoplus_\mathcal{F} \cInd_{\hat K_\mathcal{F}}^G\, V[\phi_\mathcal{F}],$$ where $\mathcal{F}$ ranges over a set of representatives of $G$-conjugacy classes of $d$-dimensional facets in $\BSigma$.
